options.mcpaintfix.title: MC Paint Fix
options.mcpaintfix.enabled.tooltip: Draw each MC Paint canvas as one texture instead of one glyph per run of pixels. Off falls back to vanilla rendering.
options.mcpaintfix.debug.tooltip: Report what the mod is doing in chat and in the log. Off, the mod only reports genuine faults, and only to the log.
options.mcpaintfix.export_png.tooltip: Save every decoded canvas to .paints/<server>/ with an index of where it hangs. An archive, not a speed-up.
options.mcpaintfix.skip_text_layout.tool: Also skip vanilla's line splitting for canvases being replaced. Most of the saving on canvases that change often.
options.mcpaintfix.status.mismatch: Off: this resource pack measures canvases differently
notification.mcpaintfix.disabled: Rendering MC Paint canvases the vanilla way
notification.mcpaintfix.mismatch: This resource pack measures MC Paint canvases differently than expected. Falling back to vanilla rendering for this session.
notification.mcpaintfix.undecodable: An MC Paint canvas did not decode. Falling back to vanilla rendering for it.
